about: Research only, unpublished, a dry run. Not a prediction of the 6 May 2027 elections and not vintage 1 of the pre-registered forecast (docs/preregistration-2027.md). No page reads this file. The research ward model (C2) and its half and half blend with the swing from each ward's last result (M50), trained on every contest before 28 November 2026 and anchored on the national polls of that date. Shares are full slate shares over six lanes; every party outside the five main lanes and every independent is pooled as Others. Win chances come from fixed lane spreads and are not calibrated. Coverage is incomplete: see research/ward-model-2026-11/V2027_RESULTS.md.
standing_rule: Assumed before nominations (V2027_SPEC.md): Reform UK, Labour, Conservative, Liberal Democrats and Green Party stand in every ward; Others stand where any other candidate stood at the ward's last scheduled election.
